name: ponvara
description: Security finding bus: Dependency-Track and GitHub Advanced Security → DefectDojo over the REST API (no Django ORM).

commands.sync: Pull all Dependency-Track projects and reimport findings into DefectDojo.
commands.sync-github: Pull GitHub Advanced Security findings (code scanning, Dependabot, secret scanning) for configured repos and reimport into DefectDojo.

modules.src/ponvara/config.py: pydantic-settings Config class; reads env vars / .env.
modules.src/ponvara/dependencytrack.py: DependencyTrackClient over httpx; lists projects and exports FPF findings.
modules.src/ponvara/github.py: GitHubClient over httpx; GHAS code-scanning SARIF, Dependabot alerts, secret-scanning alerts.
modules.src/ponvara/sync_github.py: run_github_sync(): orchestrates GHAS → DefectDojo sync; transforms Dependabot/secret-scanning alerts to Generic Findings Import JSON.

ci.security: Chargate SAST / MegaLinter net-new gate (pull_request only)
ci.release: Diatreme versioning + container build/push to GHCR (pull_request + push to main)
ci.docs: tremvok mkdocs → Cloudflare Pages (docs paths on main; PRs build but do not publish)

cronjobs.cronjob-github.yaml: ponvara sync-github — GitHub Advanced Security → DefectDojo
